name: חַנִּיאֵל
gloss: grace of God; or God is my favour
summary: Read as חֵן “favour” (with the connecting ־ִי) joined to אֵל, God. Borne by Hanniel son of Ephod, the prince of Manasseh chosen to divide the land of Canaan for inheritance (Num 34:23), and an Asherite, son of Ulla (1Ch 7:39).

evidence.note: “For the tribe of the sons of Manasseh, a prince, חַנִּיאֵל son of Ephod”, among those who would divide the land.
“These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the sons of Israel in the land of Canaan.”

note: Takes h.dz.ak (2 tokens). The reading is the form's; Punic names of the same build (ḥnbʿl, “grace of Baal”) are the closest parallel. No verse explains it.
